newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Donaldson Co off focus list.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Donaldson Co off focus list.

text.p: - Mesirow Financial said it has removed Donaldson Co Inc from its focus list, as the share price has reached the lower end of the Mesirow's $36 to $38 price target.

- In a release dated March 21, Mesirow analyst Gary Prestopino said Donaldson's fundamental outlook continues to be strong, but Friday's price of $36.63, 19 times the earnings estimate for fiscal 1997, is fair valuation.
- Mesirow continues to rate the stock a buy, but has removed it from its focus list.
- Shares of Donaldson were off 1/2 at 36-1/8.
